stops.name: Olivella
stops.detail: The remains of the Eramprunyà and Olivella castles, among the most classic hiking routes in Garraf, illustrate the period of the March wars against the Saracens.

stops.name: iglesia de Olivella
stops.detail: A good example of the Romanesque style in the area is the small church of Olivella.
